hypotheses: H1: The first-line A375 activity labels reflect compound-specific responses that may transfer to other lines; choosing a second line with a distinct tissue context could yield one active and one inactive label per compound, maximizing the count of compounds with both labels.

H2: The first-line A375 activity labels are dominated by shared systematic or vehicle-threshold effects, so second-line labels may be largely concordant with A375, producing few compounds with one active and one inactive line.
evidence_gaps: No measured second-line activity labels are available yet.
Tissue-specific target dependence is not established for these compounds.
The relationship between L1000 activity and viability or mechanism is not established.
Database annotations and MOA are weaker than measured responses and do not prove causality.
